hostPrefs.body: function hostPrefs(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('mtgte_host_prefs')||'{\"smartPriority\":\"standard\",\"assist\":true,\"autoLoss\":true}')}catch{return{smartPriority:'standard',assist:true,autoLoss:true}}}function smartPriorityMode(){return typeof MTGSmartPriority!=='undefined'?MTGSmartPriority.mode(st.smartPriority?.mode||hostPrefs().smartPriority):'standard'}function setSmartPriorityMode(mode,meta={source:'host-settings'}){if(!HST)return false;mode=MTGSmartPriority.mode(mode);let changed=st.smartPriority?.mode!==mode;if(changed){emit('SMART_PRIORITY_MODE_SET',{mode},me,meta);send({t:'state',st})}if(battleStarted)setTimeout(()=>authoritativeRulesPump({source:'smart-priority-mode'}),0);return true}function syncSmartPriorityPreference(){if(!HST||typeof MTGSmartPriority==='undefined')return;setSmartPriorityMode(hostPrefs().smartPriority,{source:'host-preference'})}function pendingCommanderZoneChoices(){return Object.values(st.commanderZoneChoices?.byObject||{}).filter(Boolean)}function hasPendingCommanderZoneChoice(){return pendingCommanderZoneChoices().length>0}function rulesProgressionBlocked(){return !!(st.advancedResolutionPending||st.castingCostPending||st.replacementOrderPending||st.oracleChoicePending||(st.triggerOrderPending&&!st.triggerOrderPending.deferredUntil)||hasPendingCommanderZoneChoice())}

hostAdjustPlayer.body: function hostAdjustPlayer(id,kind){if(kind==='life')return numericControl('P'+id+' Life',st.life[id]??40,d=>{apply('life',{d},id,{source:'host-control'});renderHost()});if(kind==='poison')return numericControl('P'+id+' Poison',st.poison[id]||0,d=>{apply('counter',{k:'poison',d},id,{source:'host-control'});renderHost()});if(kind==='tax')return numericControl('P'+id+' Commander Tax',st.tax[id]||0,d=>{apply('counter',{k:'tax',d},id,{source:'host-control'});renderHost()});if(kind==='cmdCasts')return numericControl('P'+id+' Commander Casts',st.cmdCasts[id]||0,d=>{apply('counter',{k:'cmdCasts',d},id,{source:'host-control'});renderHost()})}

hostCommanderDamage.body: function hostCommanderDamage(defender){let sources=players.filter(p=>p.id!==defender);if(!sources.length)return toast('No commander sources available.');choice(sources.map(p=>'P'+p.id+' · '+(p.commander||'Commander')),pick=>{let m=pick.match(/^P(\d+)/),from=Number(m&&m[1]);if(!from)return;let key=MTGEngine.commanderKey(from),cur=(st.cmd[defender]||{})[key]||0;numericControl('P'+from+' Commander Damage → P'+defender,cur,d=>{apply('cmd',{from,commanderId:key,d},defender,{source:'host-control'});renderHost()})})}

hostUndo.body: function hostUndo(){let restored=MTGEngine.undo(st);if(!restored)return toast('Nothing to undo.');st=restored;sync();send({t:'state',st});renderHost();toast('Authoritative event undone.')}
